title: fix(app-shell): the list toolbar's density and Hide Fields are the user's own list state, not a shared-view write (objectui#12474)
body:
Fixes #12474
Clause-②: no

The console list toolbar's density toggle and its Hide Fields popover now write the signed-in user's own list state, the `ui.list.OBJECT` row objectui#12418 added (PR #12471), instead of the shared view. One user's click no longer changes the list for everyone, and a walled tenant member (`group` / `isolated`) is no longer refused. The view's authored `rowHeight` and `hiddenFields` stay the default for every user who has not chosen. "Reset view" drops both parts. After this PR no list toolbar door reaches `persistViewPatch`. The view editor's explicit save still writes `/meta/view`.

## What changed

- **`ListPreferencesProvider` (the slot module, app-shell internal).** A view's entry gains two optional parts: `rowHeight` (sanitized to the spec's five `RowHeight` values through `ROW_HEIGHT_TO_DENSITY_MODE`; any other value is dropped, not coerced) and `hiddenFields` (string names, deduplicated). An empty `hiddenFields: []` is kept, like `sort: []`: it is the user's "show every column", which is not the view's list. `null` clears one part. `resetViewPreference` already drops the whole entry, so Reset view drops both parts with no new code.
- **`ObjectView.tsx` relay.**
  - `onDensityChange` calls `listPrefs.patchView(viewDef.id, { rowHeight })`. The `rowHeight` rung reads the user's value first, then the view's folded `rowHeight`, then the list node's.
  - `persistHiddenFields` calls `listPrefs.patchView(viewDef.id, { hiddenFields })`, only where `activeViewDeclaresColumns`. The `hiddenFields` rung reads the user's list first, under the same objectui#10694 gate.
  - `persistViewPatch` left the `renderListView` dependency list. A comment at its declaration says it has no caller (see Open question).
- **Docs.** `content/docs/guide/user-state-persistence.md`, whose list-state section said density and hidden fields "are still saved to the view".
- **Changeset.** `.changeset/12474-density-hidden-user-slot.md`, `@object-ui/app-shell: patch`.

## Premise check (What to build 2): it holds, with one measured consequence

The premise is that a user's hidden fields subtract from the columns the view draws and never add a column. Measured with the real `ListView` and the real Hide Fields popover in `ObjectView.emptyColumnsNoProjection-10694.test.tsx`:
- `ListView.effectiveFields` starts from `schema.columns` and only filters it. The popover offers only `schema.columns` the caller may read (`allFields`, objectui#11984). So a stored list can only remove declared columns.
- The PREMISE pin: a view with `columns [name, stage, owner]` and authored `hiddenFields [stage]` draws `[name, owner]`. With the user's stored `hiddenFields [region]`, it draws `[name, stage, owner]`: `stage` returns (it is declared), and `region` (declared nowhere) adds nothing.
- On a view with no `columns`, the stored list is not applied (the objectui#10694 gate).
- FIELD SECURITY pin (`owner` unreadable): the popover does not offer `owner`. A hide of `region` stores `[region, owner]`, so a withheld entry is kept (objectui#11984's put-back rule), and `owner` stays undrawn.

**Consequence: a saved view that declares no `columns` is now session-only too.** Its hide used to persist only because the shared write sent the whole saved view, drawn default columns included, which declared a projection for every user. A user's own state cannot declare a projection. A stored `hiddenFields` on an unprojected view would be read by nothing, which is the objectui#10694 ruling-B reason. So `persistHiddenFields` stores only where the view declares `columns`, and that applies to system and saved views alike. The author's remedy is unchanged: declare `columns`. The old CONTROL "a saved view with no `columns` keeps persisting" is now the pin "THE CHANGE (objectui#12474)".

## Mechanism assumptions (PM's A1 to A3)

- **A1 holds.** `ListPreferencesProvider.tsx` and its types are not re-exported by `packages/app-shell/src/index.ts` (the context barrel re-exports `UserStateAdaptersProvider` and its hooks, not this module). The row value is client-owned JSON in `sys_user_preference`. No spec key and no server validation of the `ui.list.` value. The accept set of a published surface does not widen and no public surface grows, so `Clause-②: no`.
- **A2 holds, with one correction to the census half.** The view editor's save does not go through `persistViewPatch`, on `main` or here. It goes through `handleViewConfigSave` and then `persistRuntimeMetadata`. So after this PR `persistViewPatch` has zero callers. The census pin counts its references outside its declaration (0). The "editor still writes" half stays pinned live by `ObjectView.userListState-12418.test.tsx` ("the view editor's save still writes /meta/view").
- **A3 holds.** Nothing to migrate. A `rowHeight` or `hiddenFields` an earlier toolbar toggle wrote into a view stays there. It is the authored default every user sees until a user chooses their own (the relay reads the user's value, then the view's).

## Pins (new and changed)

- `consoleListStateWall-12418.test.tsx` (the budget test's fake framework, walled):
  - **new**: a density toggle and then a Hide Fields change each put 0 metadata writes on the wire, raise no `toast.error`, and land as one preference write each, of the row the boot read found (no extra read).
  - **CONTROL replaced**: the old CONTROL used the density toggle as the still-live view write, and it no longer is one. The control is now the real adapter's own `updateViewConfig` from the same tree, refused 403.
- `ObjectView.userListState-12418.test.tsx`, new block "the density and the hidden fields are the user's too (objectui#12474)":
  - density: 0 view writes and 1 `save()`;
  - Hide Fields: 0 view writes and 1 `save()`;
  - a fresh browser opens on the stored values once the family loads;
  - another user sees the authored `rowHeight: tall` and `hiddenFields: [amount]` (CONTROL);
  - Reset view drops both parts and the list returns to the authored values.
- `ListPreferencesProvider.slot-12418.test.ts`, four new cases: row-height sanitizing, hidden-field sanitizing, per-part patch and clear, and reset.
- `ObjectView.overlayPatchOnly.test.ts`:
  - the key ratchet now expects an empty write set;
  - **new census pin** "no list toolbar door reaches `persistViewPatch` (objectui#12474 census)". It strips comments, counts references beyond the declaration, requires 0, and asserts both doors call `listPrefs.patchView`.
- Rewritten because the behaviour moved (each with a note in place):
  - `toolbarWritesCompose-11642`: on each row kind, both changes survive the reload and the row is not written. The two debounce/chain cases are removed, since no toolbar write is left to queue.
  - `viewWriteRefusal-11583`: the toolbar-toggle refusal block becomes "a toolbar toggle is no view write any more".
  - `fallbackTabSessionOnly-11643`: the real rows beside the console-made tab keep the density as user state and are not written.
  - `inlineEditSessionOnly-5144`: the firing control is the adapter's own write.
  - `emptyColumnsNoProjection-10694`: as above, plus `localStorage.clear()` between cases. The stored state is per browser in this harness, and it leaked between cases.

## Ablation (one mutation, `ablation-replace.mjs`)

Mutation: the density door calls `persistViewPatch(viewDef.id, viewDef, {` again. Anchor 1 to 0, blob `c7ce79b663e1` to `851655a81294`.
- Predicted: the census pin and the 0-PUT pins go red.
- Observed: 4 red of 38 tests: the census pin, the key ratchet (now writes `rowHeight`), the userListState density pin and the wall pin.
- Restore: blob equal to HEAD (`c7ce79b663e1`), `git diff HEAD` empty.
- No `dist/` leg: the subject is the test's own package source.

## Local gates

- Type-check `@object-ui/app-shell` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, which includes the test files) after building the `@object-ui/app-shell^...` closure under the verify lock: exit 0.
- Vitest union at `a12153c40`: every `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView*` file, `writeRefusalCensus-11583`, `view-filter-fold.ratchet`, `InterfaceListPage*`, `src/console/__tests__/`, `src/context/__tests__/`, `data-objectstack` `userState.family-12418`, and the i18n `objectView-config-keys-retired-4730` pin. Result: `Test Files 114 passed (114)`, `Tests 963 passed (963)`, lock verdict command-exit 0.
- ESLint on the 11 changed TS files: 0 errors. `ObjectView.tsx` has 197 warnings against 196 at base. The +1 is `no-unused-vars` on the now-callerless `persistViewPatch`. There is no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService` in `eslint.config.js`), so the diff cannot move an untouched file's verdict.
- The pre-tsc battery, all exit 0: `check:phantom-deps`, `self-import`, `unreferenced-sources`, `doc-example-readers`, `handler-key-reads`, `side-effects-array`, `element-data-source-declaration`, `spec-symbols`, `action-forward-parity`, `designer-field-key-parity`, `icon-record-names`, `i18n-keys`, `i18n-drift`, `i18n-designer-parity`, `control-bytes`.
- Also exit 0: `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:test-path-roots`, the three `check:vi-mock-*` gates, `check:doc-json`, `check:doc-fences`, `scripts/check-doc-links.mjs`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`.
- `check-governed-queue-guard --test` on the diff: an ordinary pull request.
- `check:spec-floors` exits 1 with `no-artifact` (needs a whole-workspace build), the same as on `main` (objectui#12334). NOT MEASURED.

## Acceptance notes

- **Open question: retire the callerless toolbar write path.** After this PR `persistViewPatch` has no caller. It was also the last in-repo caller of the adapter's published `updateViewConfig`. Its private machinery is dead with it: `toolbarWriteInputs`, the write chain, `buildPersistedViewBody`, the `CONSOLE_MADE_TAB` guard and the `console.objectView.viewConfigPermissionDenied` toast key. Retiring that family crosses `@object-ui/types` (`DataSource.updateViewConfig`), `@object-ui/data-objectstack` and `@object-ui/i18n`, outside this claim's file surface. It is kept here, with a comment at the declaration and the census pin forbidding a toolbar door from returning to it.
- **Display panel "Reset to view default".** `ListView` compares density and hidden fields with what the host hands it in `schema`. That is now the user's stored value, the same as the sort since objectui#12418. So the Display panel's reset returns to the user's own choice, and the page header's "Reset view" returns to the view's. A comment in `plugin-list` `ListView` still says the console persists density and hidden fields "back into the view". It is a comment outside this surface, noted, not changed.
- **A view-config draft and a user's stored value.** An admin previewing a `rowHeight` or `hiddenFields` edit in the view settings panel sees their own stored value while they have one, as with the sort.
